source_text: Agnoscens semet ipsum remuneratur: Ego aperiam os tuum et instruam te. Beati quorum Deus os aperit. Dilata os tuum et replebo illud; Paulo sermo in adapertione oris. Contrario diabolus os aperit mendacibus, scurribus, otiosis, blasphemis; in Iudam introivit Satanas. Discretio spirituum gratia est. Deus et aures et oculos aperit — Isaiae, Agar, Elisaei puero.
pass_a_gloss: Recognizing himself he-is-rewarded: I will-open mouth your and will-instruct you. Blessed whose God mouth opens. Widen mouth your and I-will-fill it; to-Paul speech in opening of-mouth. Contrariwise devil mouth opens to-liars, jesters, idle, blasphemers; into Judas entered Satan. Discernment of-spirits grace is. God also ears and eyes opens — of-Isaiah, Hagar, of-Elisha boy.
pass_b_english: Because he advanced to self-knowledge — the greater part of wisdom — God rewards him: [[I will open your mouth and teach you what to say >> Bible:Exodus 4:12]]. Blessed are they whose mouth God opens. [[Open your mouth wide and I will fill it >> Bible:Psalm 81:10]]; Paul asks [[utterance in the opening of my mouth >> Bible:Ephesians 6:19]]. The contrary is fearful: the devil opens mouths for lies, scurrility, [[idle words >> Bible:Matthew 12:36]], and blasphemy — as [[Satan entered Judas >> Bible:John 13:27]]. [[Discernment of spirits >> Bible:1 Corinthians 12:10]] is itself a gift; [[test the spirits >> Bible:1 John 4:1]]. God likewise opens ears and eyes — Isaiah’s ear, Hagar’s well, the eyes of Elisha’s servant to the mountain full of horses and chariots.
